title: ISO 8573-4:2019 — Compressed air — Contaminant measurement — Part 4: Particle content
locator: Official abstract: sampling compressed air and determining particle size and number concentration; method limitations and uncertainty considerations are described; the method does not segregate solid and liquid particle fractions.
notes: Particle measurement method, not a universal air-purity target. Sampling and instrument selection must follow the method scope and the applicable ISO 8573-1 class statement.
